info.title: Renga operator API
info.description: API for operating a Renga deployment: organizations, policy, identity providers, usage, and transfers. It is served only on the operator listener, and requests authenticate with an operator token.

Deployment.title: Deployment
Deployment.description: Facts about this deployment as a whole.

identifier.description: The deployment identifier new intake keys carry (RFD 23), or null when the deployment has none.

url.description: The public URL people and agents reach this deployment at.

OperatorError.title: OperatorError
OperatorError.description: Why an operator request was refused.

operatorToken.description: An operator token, created with `renga-admin operator-tokens create`.

401.description: The operator token is missing, unknown, revoked, expired, or used from an address it does not allow.

get.description: Reports the deployment identifier and public URL, so a control plane can register the deployment. Any valid operator token may read it.

401.description: The operator token is missing, unknown, revoked, expired, or used from an address it does not allow.
The operator token is missing, unknown, revoked, expired, or used from an address it does not allow.

delete.description: Any authenticated token can revoke itself and needs no scope. A token cannot list, create, or revoke another token through the API; operators do that with `renga-admin operator-tokens`.
delete.summary: Revoke the token making this request
